items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1964-04-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about Almond Vesey? Never heard of him. Never heard of him. They may have been after your time, Papa.

ctx.x: Well, I played out there all the time. I had bands out there regular. You played at the West End? Well, I never heard of this band.

What about Almond Vesey? Never heard of him. Never heard of him. They may have been after your time, Papa. Must have been late bands. Must have been. Yeah. It couldn't have been around my time. Papa, let me ask you something. Did you ever go to any colored funeral marches when you were a child? No. Never did go to those colored funerals? No. No.
